## Summary

Describe the media workflow, bug, documentation, or maintenance change.

## Behavior

- What changes for users?
- Which command or preset is affected?
- Does the generated FFmpeg command change?

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `pytest -q`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I kept subprocess invocation shell-free.
- [ ] I preserved explicit overwrite protection.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not add private media, secrets, credentials, or copyrighted fixtures without permission.

## Notes

Include sanitized example commands or output when they make the change easier to review.
